headline: President Clinton's 1994 order bans certain business and financial dealings involving Haiti.
what_it_does: This executive order prohibits certain transactions involving Haiti. Without a summary, the exact types of transactions covered and any exceptions cannot be confirmed from the title alone. It was issued in 1994, a period when the United States was using economic sanctions over Haiti's military government.

who_it_affects.group: US businesses and individuals who deal with Haiti
who_it_affects.how: They are barred from certain transactions involving Haiti, though the title does not say which ones.
